desc:
Try on outfits & get inspired to create your perfect avatar!

🛍️ Browse items of different outfits!
🛒 Any purchase made in-game will stay on your Avatar!
🌟 PRIVATE SERVERS 10R$ ONLY!

How to load outfits:
1. Click the button on the screen called 'Load User' and input the username of the player you want to see outfits for.
2. Now the outfits will load, click on them to see the items and try the outfit!
